releases.notes:
## Paper Plane 2.0.0

A complete architectural & UX overhaul of Paper Plane across **Minecraft 1.20.1, 1.21.1, and 26.1.2**.

### Highlights
- **Zero external library bloat**: Removed `RinLib` completely — only requires **FTB Library** and **FTB Essentials**.
- **New Player Picker UI**: Scrollable player list with skin head avatars and live case-insensitive search (press **Enter** when narrowed to a single player to send immediately).
- **Zero-Loss Settlement**: Single-use `Paper Plane` and `Back Paper Plane` are consumed **only after** a teleport actually completes. Canceled, denied, or failed teleports never consume an item.
- **4 Craftable Planes**:
  - `Paper Plane` (single-use `/tpa`) & `Ender Paper Plane` (reusable `/tpa`)
  - `Back Paper Plane` (single-use `/back`) & `Ender Back Paper Plane` (reusable `/back`)
- **Native Config & Hot Reload**: `config/paper_plane.toml` hot-reloads automatically on edit, plus an in-game Config Screen (Mod Menu on Fabric, Mods menu on Forge / NeoForge).
- **Standard 3D Item Models & New 512×512 Icon**: Clean `minecraft:item/generated` item models with 16×16 textures.
- **Lossless 1.x Save Migration**: Legacy `paper_plane:soggy_paper_plane` items in inventories/containers are automatically remapped to `paper_plane:paper_plane`.

### Supported Matrix
| Minecraft | Loaders | Java |
|---|---|---|
| `1.20.1` | Fabric, Forge | 17 |
| `1.21.1` | Fabric, NeoForge | 21 |
| `26.1.2` | Fabric, NeoForge | 25 |

releases.notes:
## Paper Plane 1.2.0

### Changes & Improvements
- **Direct player selection**: Right-clicking or sneak-right-clicking with any paper plane now directly opens the player selection list. Charging, launching, and throw consumption have been removed.
- **Teleport accept handling**: The server teleport acceptance boundary now verifies that the active FTB Essentials request's target UUID matches the accepting player before delegating processing directly to FTB Essentials, preserving native target validation and payment handling. The deprecated fallback chat command execution path has been removed, and rapid clicks or expired requests terminate cleanly.
- **Compatibility & behavior**: Retains the unexpired session reuse fix from 1.1.2 when reopening player selection with the same paper plane type (preserving the original 30-second window). Existing paper plane entity types remain registered so worlds with existing in-flight entities can still load. Teleport payment mechanics upon acceptance (consuming standard/wet planes and preserving reusable Ender Paper Planes) remain unchanged.
* **Important:** Both client and server must be updated to 1.2.0 due to network protocol changes.

## Paper Plane 1.1.1

- Require RinLib across all supported Minecraft versions and loaders.
- Share flight, selection and teleport handling across version profiles.
- Prevent stale selection requests from cancelling a newer selection screen.
- Validate the recipient before accepting or denying a Paper Plane request.
- Fix Fabric dependency ranges on Minecraft 1.19.2 and 1.20.1.
- Fix item registration on Minecraft 26.1.2.

Requires FTB Essentials, FTB Library and RinLib. Fabric also requires Fabric API. Install the file matching your Minecraft version and mod loader.
